console.cmd.traderreport.desc: Acceptance only: publish one give report (item instance + claimed credit) at a trader position.
console.cmd.op.desc: Host only: grant another player the cheat verbs (/data's write verbs, /give, /summon, /heal, /gamerule).
console.cmd.deop.desc: Host only: revoke another player's cheat verbs.
console.cmd.help.desc: List available commands or show one command's usage.
console.cmd.rtt.desc: Show the last measured round-trip time.
console.cmd.whoami.desc: Show local role, SteamId and session state.
console.cmd.gamemode.desc: Cheat verb: switch between normal play and spectator mode.
console.cmd.heal.desc: Immediately fully reset the selected player(s): health, limbs, severed limbs and the hollow debuff (a cheat verb).
console.cmd.kick.desc: Host only: kick a member by SteamId or display name.
console.cmd.ban.desc: Host only: ban a member by SteamId or display name.
console.cmd.gamerule.desc: Read or set one host rule, shaped like Minecraft's /gamerule (a cheat verb: the host, or a member the host granted).
console.cmd.data.desc: Read or write one item's recorded state as SNBT: get, merge, modify or remove.
console.cmd.give.desc: Give one item to a player's inventory, its state already set (a cheat verb).
console.cmd.spectate.desc: Watch a teammate's body while in spectator mode (/gamemode spectator).
console.cmd.save.desc: Save the world now: a CUO world-archive cut at the next pump boundary.
console.cmd.summon.desc: Create one world entity, animal or loose item entity at a position (a cheat verb).
console.cmd.data.usage: /data get <target> [<path>] | /data merge <target> <snbt> | /data modify <target> <path> <set|merge|append|prepend|insert <n>> <snbt> | /data remove <target> <path> -- target: [<selector>] slot <n> | cursor | id <n>
